trace.question: On average how many carcinogenic molecules are single bonded?
trace.evidence: carcinogenic molecules refers to label = '+'; single-bonded refers to bond_type = '-'; average = DIVIDE(SUM(bond_type = '-'), COUNT(atom_id))

attempts.sql:
SELECT CAST(SUM(b.bond_type = '-') AS REAL) / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS average_single_bonded
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'

trace.final_sql:
SELECT CAST(SUM(b.bond_type = '-') AS REAL) / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS average_single_bonded
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
trace.answer: On average, carcinogenic molecules have about 0.82 single bonds each.
